turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Someone spilled red wine on our beige carpet last night and I need to pick a fix.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Blotting it with cold water and dish soap, which my neighbour swears by.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Using that carpet stain spray from the supermarket, the oxygen one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Renting a carpet cleaning machine for the weekend and doing the whole room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with the cold water and soap, it's cheap and often enough on a fresh stain. If a shadow is left, the oxygen spray is the next step, and the rented machine is worth it if the rest of the carpet needs a refresh anyway.
